products.description: The TEGO Core Yoga Mat is a premium 8mm thick exercise mat designed for superior comfort, grip, and posture alignment. Made from eco-friendly TPE material, it offers excellent cushioning to protect joints during workouts. The built-in alignment lines help maintain correct posture, making it ideal for beginners and experienced users alike. Lightweight and portable, it comes with a carry bag for easy transport.
